BiblicalUsage: Beeroth means "wells." It was a Gibeonite city allotted to Benjamin. It turns up in Joshua 9:17, Joshua 18:25 and 2 Samuel 4:2.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Beeroth marks real ground in God's story, not a made-up setting.
